kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_context_switches_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_intr_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS Context_switches = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_context_switches_total)), Interrupts = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_intr_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.instance`, `labels.job`, Context_switches, Interrupts
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_load1 IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_load5 IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_load15 IS NOT NULL
| STATS Load_1m = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_load1)), Load_5m = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_load5)), Load_15m = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_load15)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.instance`, `labels.job`, Load_1m, Load_5m, Load_15m
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_cpu_scaling_frequency_max_hertz IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_cpu_scaling_frequency_min_hertz IS NOT NULL
| STATS CPU = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz)), Max = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_cpu_scaling_frequency_max_hertz)), Min = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_cpu_scaling_frequency_min_hertz)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.cpu
| EVAL cpu_label = CONCAT("CPU ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(labels.cpu), ""))
| EVAL __labels = CASE(labels.cpu == "0", MV_APPEND(MV_APPEND(cpu_label, "Max"), "Min"), cpu_label)
| EVAL __values = CASE(labels.cpu == "0", MV_APPEND(MV_APPEND(COALESCE(TO_STRING(CPU), ""), COALESCE(TO_STRING(Max), "")), COALESCE(TO_STRING(Min), "")), COALESCE(TO_STRING(CPU), ""))
| EVAL __pairs = MV_ZIP(__labels, __values, "~")
| MV_EXPAND __pairs
| EVAL series_group = MV_FIRST(SPLIT(__pairs, "~")), value = TO_DOUBLE(MV_LAST(SPLIT(__pairs, "~")))
| KEEP time_bucket, series_group, value
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_pressure_io_waiting_seconds_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_pressure_io_stalled_seconds_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS CPU_some = AVG(RATE(metrics.node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total)), Memory_some = AVG(RATE(metrics.node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total)), Memory_full = AVG(RATE(metrics.node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_total)), I_O_some = AVG(RATE(metrics.node_pressure_io_waiting_seconds_total)), I_O_full = AVG(RATE(metrics.node_pressure_io_stalled_seconds_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.instance`, `labels.job`, CPU_some, Memory_some, Memory_full, I_O_some, I_O_full
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_interrupts_total IS NOT NULL
